title: Pest Control
description: A farmer asks you to drive a pack of wolves away from her herd before they come back for a second night.
success_text: You track the pack to a den past the tree line and scatter them with a few well-placed blows.
failure_text: The wolves scatter into the brush before you can pin them down, and you can't be sure they won't be back.

title: Heavy Lifting
description: The innkeeper needs a cellar's worth of ale barrels hauled up from the river dock before the evening crowd arrives.
success_text: You haul the last barrel up the cellar stairs just as the first patrons walk in.
failure_text: You strain your back halfway through and have to call for help to finish the job.

title: The Stuck Cart
description: A trade cart has sunk axle-deep in mud on the road in, and its owner can't free it alone.
success_text: You brace your shoulder against the wheel and heave the cart free in one go.
failure_text: The cart doesn't budge, and you nearly end up in the mud yourself.

title: The Collapsed Well
description: Rubble from a cracked wall has fallen into the town well, and someone needs to clear it before the water turns foul.
success_text: You clear the last of the stone from the well shaft, and clean water starts flowing again.
failure_text: You manage to shift some of the rubble, but a stubborn slab won't move no matter how you brace yourself.

title: Bar Brawl
description: A tavern fight is about to spill out into the street, and the owner wants it broken up before someone gets seriously hurt.
success_text: You wade in, separate the two biggest brawlers bodily, and the fight fizzles out.
failure_text: You get shoved into a table for your trouble, and the brawl keeps going without you.

title: The Stubborn Mule
description: A merchant's pack mule has planted its hooves in the market square and refuses to move an inch.
success_text: You get a shoulder under the mule's pack and half-carry, half-drag the whole load clear.
failure_text: The mule plants itself even harder, and the merchant has to wait for a second opinion.

title: Felling the Old Oak
description: A woodcutter needs help bringing down a rot-diseased oak before it falls on its own and takes a house with it.
success_text: Between the two of you, the old oak comes down clean, well clear of every nearby roof.
failure_text: The oak groans and shifts but holds, and the woodcutter calls it off before someone gets hurt.

title: The Grain Press
description: The town's grain press has jammed solid with the harvest piling up outside, and someone needs to force it loose.
success_text: You throw your full weight against the press lever and it finally gives way with a crack.
failure_text: The press holds firm, and the grain keeps piling up while someone runs for a crowbar.

title: The Baker's Cat
description: A baker's cat is stuck on a steep, slick rooftop, and no one else in town will climb up after it.
success_text: You inch along the ridge line, scoop up the yowling cat, and climb back down without a scratch.
failure_text: You slip on a loose shingle halfway up and have to climb back down empty-handed.

title: Eyes on the Market
description: A stall owner wants someone quick enough to catch the pickpocket who's been working the market square.
success_text: You spot the pickpocket's hand dip into a passing cloak and catch their wrist before they can run.
failure_text: By the time you push through the crowd, the thief - and the stolen purse - are long gone.

title: The Falling Scaffold
description: A mason's scaffold is coming apart overhead, and the tools on it are about to rain down on the street below.
success_text: You dart in and catch the last falling tool a hair's breadth above a passerby's head.
failure_text: You're not fast enough - the tools scatter across the cobblestones, but at least no one's hurt.

title: Threading the Needle
description: A message needs to reach the far side of town through a packed festival crowd without whoever's watching the sender noticing.
success_text: You slip through the crush of bodies and deliver the message without drawing a single glance.
failure_text: You get boxed in by the crowd and the message arrives late - word was already out.

title: The Greased Pole
description: The town festival's greased-pole climb has a purse at the top, and the organizer could use a ringer to make it interesting.
success_text: You scramble up the slick pole against all odds and claim the purse to a roar from the crowd.
failure_text: You slide back down twice before giving up, to the crowd's good-natured laughter.

title: Juggler's Apprentice
description: A street performer twisted an ankle and needs someone to fill in for one show so the crowd doesn't ask for their coin back.
success_text: You keep the act going well enough that the crowd never notices the switch, and the hat comes back full.
failure_text: You drop the props twice, and the crowd drifts off before the hat gets passed around.

title: The Leaking Roof
description: A widow's roof has sprung a leak in the middle of a downpour, and someone needs to patch it from outside before the whole house floods.
success_text: You get the patch nailed down between gusts of wind and climb down soaked but successful.
failure_text: The wind and rain beat you back twice, and the leak keeps spreading.

title: Catch the Loose Hawk
description: A nobleman's prized hunting hawk has slipped its jesses and is loose over the town rooftops.
success_text: You work your way along the rooftops and coax the hawk back onto your glove just before it loses patience.
failure_text: The hawk wheels away over the walls before you can get close, and the nobleman is not pleased.

title: A Long Night's Watch
description: The town's well-keeper wants someone to stand watch overnight after reports of something fouling the water.
success_text: You stay alert through the cold night and catch a pack of raccoons raiding the well cover before they do real harm.
failure_text: Exhaustion gets the better of you around midnight, and you wake at dawn with nothing to show for the watch.

title: Foul Air
description: A miner asks you to check a flooded lower shaft for bad air before his crew goes back down.
success_text: You push through the stale air deep enough to confirm the shaft is safe, and the crew gets back to work.
failure_text: The fumes get to you faster than expected, and you stagger back out without finishing the check.

title: The Drinking Contest
description: The tavern needs a champion to represent it against a rival town's drinking contest entrant, and reputation is on the line.
success_text: You outlast the rival entrant to a standing ovation, and the tavern's honor is intact.
failure_text: You tap out two rounds early, to the rival town's considerable smugness.

title: Three Days Without Sleep
description: A grieving family needs someone to help keep a proper three-night wake, and the exhaustion is starting to show on everyone.
success_text: You stay sharp through all three nights, and the family is grateful for the steady presence.
failure_text: You nod off on the final night, though the family insists it's forgivable under the circumstances.

title: The Frozen Crossing
description: A trade cart broke through river ice and its driver needs help wading out to recover the cargo before it's lost downstream.
success_text: You push through the numbing cold and haul the last crate to shore before the current can take it.
failure_text: The cold forces you back to shore early, and a good part of the cargo is already gone.

title: Outlasting the Storm
description: A band of travelers is stranded outside the walls in a brutal storm, and someone needs to stay out with them until it passes.
success_text: You shelter the travelers through the worst of it and lead them in safely once the storm breaks.
failure_text: The storm wears you down before it wears itself out, and the travelers have to wait it out alone.

title: The Endurance Race
description: The town's annual boundary-stone race is short a competitor, and the organizer would love a strong finisher.
success_text: You cross the final boundary stone well ahead of the pack, barely winded.
failure_text: You fade in the last stretch and finish well back, though the crowd still cheers the effort.

title: Plague Watch
description: A quarantined house needs someone to tend the sick inside without succumbing themselves.
success_text: You tend every patient through the worst of it and walk out healthy, to the relief of the whole street.
failure_text: You start showing symptoms yourself and have to be relieved early - thankfully nothing serious.

title: The Merchant's Ledger
description: A merchant suspects his accountant is skimming coin and wants someone to make sense of three years of tangled ledgers.
success_text: You trace the discrepancy to a pattern of falsified shipping costs, exactly as the merchant feared.
failure_text: The numbers are a maze, and after hours of cross-checking you're no closer to an answer.

title: A Half-Burned Map
description: A scholar at the town archive wants help deciphering a half-burned map rumored to mark an old supply cache.
success_text: You piece together enough of the scorched map to give the scholar a workable set of directions.
failure_text: The surviving fragments don't line up no matter how you arrange them, and the scholar sighs in defeat.

title: The Cipher Letter
description: A guard captain has intercepted a coded letter and wants someone sharp enough to break it before the trail goes cold.
success_text: You work out the substitution pattern and hand over a plainly-readable letter, much to the captain's satisfaction.
failure_text: The cipher resists every approach you try, and the letter stays stubbornly unreadable.

title: Appraising the Hoard
description: An estate sale needs someone to correctly value a jumbled pile of mixed goods before the heirs start arguing over it.
success_text: You sort the pile into a fair, well-reasoned valuation that even the quarreling heirs can't dispute.
failure_text: Your estimate is wide enough off the mark that the heirs call in someone else to redo it.

title: The Faulty Waterwheel
description: The mill's waterwheel keeps jamming at the worst possible times, and the miller needs someone to work out why.
success_text: You spot a warped paddle throwing the whole wheel off balance and the miller fixes it on the spot.
failure_text: You can't pin down the cause, and the wheel keeps jamming just as it always has.

title: A Scholar's Wager
description: A traveling scholar has challenged the tavern regulars to a trivia wager, and someone needs to take her up on it.
success_text: You out-answer the scholar question for question, and she pays the wager with good humor.
failure_text: The scholar's questions run circles around you, and the tavern enjoys the show at your expense.

title: The Forged Deed
description: Two families are disputing a land boundary, and the magistrate wants a second set of eyes on the deed in question.
success_text: You catch an inconsistency in the deed's wording that proves it was altered after the fact.
failure_text: The deed looks legitimate to you, and the dispute heads to a costly formal hearing instead.

title: Star Charts
description: An astronomer needs her star charts corrected before the town's harvest festival, which is timed by the old calculations.
success_text: You work through the astronomer's figures and correct a drift that's been throwing off the calendar for years.
failure_text: The calculations are beyond untangling in the time you have, and the festival date stays uncertain.

title: The Goat Problem
description: A herder's prize goat has wandered off, and she's convinced it's gotten itself stuck somewhere stupid again.
success_text: You follow a trail of chewed hedges to a ravine, where the goat is standing exactly as stuck as predicted.
failure_text: You lose the trail at the edge of town, and the goat is nowhere to be found.

title: A Traveler's Fever
description: A sick traveler at the inn needs someone with a steady eye to tell a bad fever from something worse.
success_text: You recognize the symptoms as an ordinary road fever and talk the innkeeper through a safe remedy.
failure_text: You can't tell what's wrong with the traveler, and the innkeeper sends for someone more qualified.

title: Reading the Weather
description: The farmers want someone who can read the signs well enough to warn them before a storm ruins the harvest.
success_text: You spot the signs a full day early, and the harvest gets brought in safe before the storm hits.
failure_text: The storm catches everyone off guard, your warning included, and some of the crop is lost.

title: The Lost Child
description: A child has wandered off near dusk, and the family is growing frantic as the light fades.
success_text: You read the signs right and find the child curled up asleep behind the old mill, safe and sound.
failure_text: You search until well after dark without luck, though thankfully someone else finds the child safe.

title: A Liar's Tell
description: A theft has three witnesses telling three different stories, and the magistrate wants someone to work out who's lying.
success_text: You catch the one witness whose story keeps shifting, and the magistrate gets to the truth of it.
failure_text: All three witnesses seem equally convincing to you, and the case stalls without an answer.

title: The Orphaned Fawn
description: A hunter found an orphaned fawn too weak to survive alone and asks for help nursing it back to health.
success_text: You know exactly how much to feed it and when, and the fawn is bounding around within the week.
failure_text: Despite your best efforts, the fawn doesn't improve, and the hunter takes over the care himself.

title: Omens in the Smoke
description: A worried farmer wants a second opinion on a wandering druid's smoke-reading before he acts on it.
success_text: You read the same signs the druid did and confirm her warning is sound, easing the farmer's mind.
failure_text: The smoke's meaning escapes you entirely, and the farmer is left no less worried than before.

title: The Wary Guard Dog
description: A warehouse guard dog has stopped trusting its handler after a rough scare, and someone needs to calm it down.
success_text: You read the dog's body language right and win its trust back within the hour.
failure_text: The dog stays skittish no matter what you try, and the handler has to start over from scratch.

title: An Overdue Debt
description: A shopkeeper wants someone persuasive to collect a long-overdue debt from a notoriously stubborn customer.
success_text: You talk the debtor down from indignant to apologetic, and the coin changes hands without a fight.
failure_text: The debtor digs in and throws you out before you can get a word of the shopkeeper's case across.

title: Feuding Neighbors
description: Two neighboring households have been feuding over a property line for a decade, and the town elder wants it settled quietly.
success_text: You get both sides to agree to a boundary stone neither of them is thrilled about, which the elder calls a fair compromise.
failure_text: Both households dig in harder the moment you try to mediate, and the shouting starts before you can finish a sentence.

title: The Nervous Bride
description: A bride is paralyzed with wedding-day nerves, and someone needs to talk her back into walking down the aisle.
success_text: A few well-chosen words later, she's laughing and ready to walk out with her head high.
failure_text: Nothing you say seems to land, and her sister has to take over the pep talk.

title: Talking Down the Mob
description: An angry crowd has gathered outside the magistrate's door over a ruling they don't like, and tempers are rising fast.
success_text: You get the crowd's attention and talk the anger down to grumbling before anyone does something they'll regret.
failure_text: The crowd shouts over you, and the magistrate's guards end up handling it the hard way.

title: The Traveling Bard's Rival
description: A visiting bard has challenged the tavern's own performer to a battle of songs, and the house needs a strong showing.
success_text: Your turn at the song wins the room over completely, and the visiting bard concedes with good grace.
failure_text: The crowd's cheers go to the visiting bard, and the tavern's pride takes a small hit.

title: Negotiating the Toll
description: A caravan master thinks the road toll is unreasonably steep and wants someone to negotiate a fairer price.
success_text: You talk the toll-keeper into a price both sides can live with, and the caravan rolls on.
failure_text: The toll-keeper won't budge an inch, and the caravan master pays full price grumbling.

title: The Reluctant Witness
description: A frightened witness to a crime refuses to testify, and the magistrate's case is falling apart without them.
success_text: You reassure the witness enough that they agree to testify, and the case moves forward.
failure_text: The witness stays frightened into silence no matter what you offer, and the case stalls.

title: First Impressions
description: A visiting noble is touring the town weighing where to invest, and the council wants someone charming to make the case for it.
success_text: The noble leaves thoroughly charmed and promises to send word of a generous investment.
failure_text: The noble stays politely unimpressed, and the council will have to make its case some other way.
